title: 第9章 鸩占鹊巢古岩暴蜥第10章 蜕变甲级御兽师天赋破灭魔瞳
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 二者继续前进。
石林内的妖兽数量不少，除了常见的红毛铠猪，时不时，还能遇见一些稀奇古怪的土属性妖兽。
路过处乱石堆，一团不起眼的青石突然剧烈颤动，如绽放花苞，显露出臃肿身形。
这，是一只精英级别的一阶石巨人。
身高一米，体态胖成一团青皮石球，青钢石铸就而成的皮肤坚不可摧，上面长满零星青苔。
堪比人类的憨态面容，挂着副刚睡醒的朦胧。
石巨人，一种性格温和，极其社恐的妖兽。
畏生，嗜睡，长寿，喜欢独居、晒太阳。
其繁衍方式也很特殊，十岁成年，无需伴侣。
石巨人成年后。
每隔一年，皆会分裂出一只普通级石娃娃。
警惕的看了眼夜玄与鹿二发，石巨人低吼一声，身躯蜷成青球轰隆滚离，于地面留下一道长长滚动印痕…
鹿二发见状松了口气，他擦了擦额头汗水，指向前方道，“夜少，前面不远处就是被斩夜螳螂占据的黑晶矿脉，咱们接下来需做好准备。”
“先找个地方养精蓄锐，我来制作白石兽粉。”
二人一拍即合，寻了处隐蔽地临时休憩…
叼着根狗尾巴草，夜玄背靠石柱，静静观摩鹿二发制作白石兽粉。
思索会，似乎想起某些事情，夜玄无声离开。
等再次回归，怀中已是多出数份杂七杂八材料。
果实薄壳、树皮编织而成的麻绳、一堆青黄色石粉、烧焦的木炭、橄树树油等等。
“夜少，你这…”
鹿二发有些纳闷。
“做个简易炸药包。”
“爆炸时，能加剧白石兽粉扩散，减少风险。”
“石巨人的尿液中蕴含硫磺等成分，与木炭进行融合，即为威力强大的黑火药。”
“可惜，刚刚那只遇见的石巨人尚未成年。”
“排出的尿液有限…”
夜玄说着，开始熟练摆弄拼装，轻车熟路。
土炸药这东西，他熟悉的很。
上一世蓝星，爷爷经常带着自己用自制土枪上山打野味，打不到，就用土质炸药包炸鱼…
鹿二发沉默，袖袍拳头紧握，眼中闪过抹难以掩藏的忌惮。
世人都道夜家私生子夜玄，是个不学无术的纨绔。
终日沉溺酒色，荒唐度日。
可短暂相处，鹿二发却暗自心惊。
这传言。

Both moved on.
There are a lot of monsters in the stone forest. In addition to the common red-haired armored pigs, from time to time, you can also encounter some weird earth-type monsters.
Passing by a pile of rocks, a group of inconspicuous bluestones suddenly trembled violently, like a flower bud blooming, revealing its bloated figure.
This is an elite level one stone giant.
He is one meter tall, and his body is as fat as a ball of green leather. His skin is indestructible and covered with sporadic moss.
His face was as naive as a human being, with a hazy look as if he had just woken up.
The stone giant is a kind of monster with a gentle personality and extremely social fear.
Fear of life, lethargy, longevity, like to live alone and bask in the sun.
Its reproduction method is also very special. It reaches adulthood at the age of ten and does not need a partner.
The stone giant becomes an adult.
Every other year, an ordinary-level stone doll will split into pieces.
"Roar!"
Looking at Ye Xuan and Lu Erfa warily, the stone giant roared, curled up into a green ball and rolled away, leaving a long rolling mark on the ground...
Lu Erfa breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this. He wiped the sweat from his forehead and pointed forward, "Young Master Ye, not far ahead is the black crystal vein occupied by the Night-Slaying Praying Mantis. We need to be prepared next."
"First find a place to recharge your batteries, and I'll make White Stone Beast Powder."
"Okay."
The two hit it off immediately and found a secluded place to rest temporarily...
Holding a dog's tail grass in his mouth, Ye Xuan leaned against the stone pillar and quietly watched Lu Erfa making white stone animal powder.
After thinking for a while, he seemed to remember something, and Ye Xuan left silently.
When he returned again, he already had several miscellaneous materials in his arms.
Thin fruit shells, hemp ropes woven from tree bark, a pile of blue-yellow stone powder, burnt charcoal, olive oil, etc.
"Young Master Ye, you..."
Lu Erfa was a little puzzled.
"Make a simple explosive bag."
"When it explodes, it can intensify the spread of white stone animal powder and reduce risks."
"The stone giant's urine contains sulfur and other ingredients. When combined with charcoal, it becomes powerful black gunpowder."
"Unfortunately, the stone giant we just met is not yet an adult."
"Limited urine output..."
“…”
Ye Xuan said, and began to assemble it skillfully, and he was familiar with the road.
He was very familiar with earth-explosives.
In the previous life of Blue Star, my grandfather often took him to the mountains to hunt game with his homemade gun. If he couldn't catch it, he would use clay explosives to fry the fish...
Lu Erfa was silent, his sleeves and fists were clenched, and there was an unconcealable fear in his eyes.
Everyone knows that Ye Xuan, the illegitimate son of the Ye family, is an ignorant and ignorant playboy.
Indulging in wine and sex all day long, living absurdly.
But after getting along for a short time, Lu Erfa was secretly frightened.
This rumor.
